sampling: First 200 SHA256([seed,id])-ordered validation IDs; first 20 passing structure and complete-context tokenizer preflight, never gold or model-based selection.
replay: Append two rounds of the top three source sentences by distinct lowercase ASCII-word overlap with question (title plus sentence); ties use original sentence order. No gold selection.
dedup_baseline: Canonical source-sentence dedup of replay is byte-identical to raw_once, asserted and aliased by design; not a separate call or independent observation.
limits: A repeated-presentation policy changes length, salience and position jointly; it does not isolate statistical double-counting or social conformity.
Trusted source coordinates identify text origins, not independent evidence or semantic equivalence.
Private S0 then all-context reconsideration is controlled evidence exchange, not regenerated peer debate or certified computational reuse.
No novel DICE efficacy claim, no general verifier, and no benefit of verdict delay is assumed.
Single-union is a lower-cost reference with no own-history, not equal-realized-compute comparison.
Question-only success need not imply memorization; do not drop those questions.
Twenty short-context development items and greedy calls are not confirmatory evidence; bootstrap unit is question, not agent.
Invalid model outputs score zero for all-planned pipeline metrics and are separately reported; infrastructure failure blocks full scoring and is never imputed.
No output repair, retries, seed changes, truncation, effect-based stopping, or automatic follow-up batch.
decision: Inspect completed coverage and question-level contrasts before any next batch. If no consistent repetition-related degradation, do not scale this mechanism or claim a remedy; discuss and retain the result. A signal here still needs a genuine reuse algorithm, ordinary dedup/memoization controls, fresh questions and models.
